summary: BioWare and EA's Anthem was an online-only looter shooter/action RPG that is no longer playable after its official January 2026 server shutdown.

entries.title: Anthem
entries.definitive_edition: No current official playable edition; preserve pre-shutdown captures and documentation

emulation.notes: Online-only official service is shut down.

primary.version: Official game no longer playable after January 12, 2026
primary.why: EA's official shutdown notice states that Anthem's servers were available until January 12, 2026 and that the online-only game would no longer be playable after that date. Since the current date is after shutdown, archive work should preserve prior footage, metadata, builds, and documentation rather than planning a new normal playthrough.
primary.how_to_play: No normal official play route remains. Archive existing legally captured footage, screenshots, save/account notes, build/version data, Javelin/loadout records, mission/freeplay details, and any pre-shutdown server-state notes. Clearly label any future private-server work as unofficial if it ever exists.

secondary.platform: Windows PC / PlayStation 4 / Xbox One pre-shutdown
secondary.exclusive_content: Original live-service play state before January 12, 2026
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if already captured or if historically preserved account footage exists.
secondary.why: The official online service is gone.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not list EA Play, disc ownership, or installed files as playable routes unless an official service returns.
